fields.acceptance: A Go test of the stall cutoff: working at 19 minutes is not stalled, at 21 minutes is, blocked, idle and usage-paused sessions never are; a testscript with a hand-written session record and RHIZA_TEST_NOW shows 'stalled' in run status only past the cutoff
fields.statement: rhiza run status marks a live session stalled when its hook status is working and its last report is more than 20 minutes old, unless it is paused for a usage limit

fields.acceptance: inbox-stalled.txtar: with a working session record last reported at T and a live run journal, rhiza inbox --json has no stalled item at T+19m and one of kind stalled at T+21m; a blocked or idle record gives none; the inbox app test shows the stalled group
fields.statement: rhiza inbox lists each stalled session of a live run as a stalled item naming the session and its run, with rhiza session message as the next step, and the inbox app shows them
